summary: ACDE #249 形成粗略共识：Glamsterdam 按现有规范推进，EIP-8037 不改，Hoodi 测试网分叉暂定 12 月 14 日那一周，下次 ACDC 做最终决定；ChainSecurity 公开的影响评估显示 200 个问题里 182 个与写死的 gas 预算有关。Hegotá 方面，“取消 frames 改为内置 PQ”的选项无人支持，各客户端团队需在下周末前提交书面立场，FOCIL 去留交给接下来两次 ACDC。把 EIP-8141 的 MAX_VERIFY_GAS 提到 30 万的 PR 补齐了 7 个执行层客户端的基准，最坏情况拒绝耗时中位数 3.1 到 5.3 毫秒。

items.title: Besu 关于 EIP-8037 和 Glamsterdam 的立场
items.note: 2026-11-19 14:26，jflo 在 ACDE 议题下给出两个选项：推迟 Glamsterdam 并极窄地修改 EIP-8037 中“剩余 gas 会增加”的新行为（放弃 Sepolia），或把 EIP-8037 移出 Glamsterdam 放进 Hegotá。Besu 倾向前者，认为写死 gas 价格的合约损坏可以接受，但 try/catch 类函数被破坏不可接受。Ansgar 的回复 19:26 指出还有“按现状发布”的第三个选项，且修改 EIP-8037 只能缓解少数受影响合约，多数问题来自写死的 gas 价格。
items.title_en: Besu's position on EIP-8037 and Glamsterdam
items.note_en: 2026-11-19 14:26. jflo posted two options on the ACDE issue: delay Glamsterdam and make an extremely narrow change to EIP-8037's new "remaining gas can increase" behaviour (sacrificing Sepolia), or move EIP-8037 out of Glamsterdam into Hegotá. Besu prefers the first. It sees broken contracts with hard-coded gas pricing as an acceptable loss, but not broken try/catch-style functions. Ansgar's reply at 19:26 pointed out a third option, shipping as is, and noted that changing EIP-8037 would only help a minority of affected contracts, since most breakage comes from hard-coded gas pricing.

items.title: ChainSecurity：EIP-8037 与 EIP-8038 影响评估
items.note: X 帖 2026-11-19 17:39：EF 委托的评估（报告完成于 11-18）结合 AI 代理审查和一年主网交易轨迹回放，共 200 个问题，3 个高危、30 个中危、167 个低危，没有严重级；受影响的有跨链桥和消息系统、钱包、交易所、治理、预言机、质押协议和链下服务，后果从运营中断到资金锁定。大多数可通过改配置修复，24 个需要升级合约或迁移。
items.title_en: ChainSecurity: EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 impact assessment
items.note_en: X post 2026-11-19 17:39. The EF-commissioned assessment (report completed 11-18) combined AI agent reviews with replays of a year of mainnet transaction traces. It covers 200 findings: 3 High, 30 Medium, 167 Low and none Critical. Affected systems include bridges and messaging, wallets, exchanges, governance, oracles, staking protocols and off-chain services, with consequences ranging from interrupted operations to locked funds. Most can be fixed through configuration; 24 need contract upgrades or migration.

items.title: ilitteri 回复
items.note: 22:17：都会这样写，目标是这个 EIP 下有效的 frame 在 8288 下字节完全一致；每个三元组都带方案字段，以后加新方案只需分叉启用一个新 id，不改 frame 或交易格式；账户仍可在 VERIFY 里用 EVM 验证作为不需要分叉的路径。
items.note_en: At 22:17 that both are how the draft is being written: a frame valid under this EIP should be byte-identical under 8288. Every triple carries its scheme, so a later scheme only needs one new id enabled by a fork, with no change to the frame or transaction format. Accounts can still verify in the EVM inside VERIFY as the no-fork path.

items.title: Toni 在 Magicians 的意见
items.note: FOCIL 争论继续：Toni 在 Magicians 的意见 2026-11-18 13:57（X 版 14:07）主张 PQ 走“精简”分叉（Frames、leanVM、DC），FOCIL 等 PQ 共识形态明确后再回来，只同时发布加固和简化。Ladislaus 反驳 18:17：还没说清推迟 FOCIL 能加速什么，社区对 FOCIL 支持压倒性，现在重开 SFI 决定为时过早。fradamt 15:10 支持集中精力做 PQ 和加固。
items.note_en: The FOCIL debate continued. Toni's comment on Magicians at 2026-11-18 13:57 (X version at 14:07) argued for doing PQ as "slim" feature forks (Frames, leanVM, DC), bringing FOCIL back once PQ consensus is clearer, and shipping only hardening and simplifications alongside. Ladislaus pushed back at 18:17: nobody has shown what deferring FOCIL would speed up, community support for FOCIL has been overwhelming, and reopening SFI decisions now is premature. fradamt at 15:10 backed a singular focus on PQ and hardening.

items.title: EIP-8502：动态个体合并激励
items.note: （PR #12673）2026-11-19 02:11，aelowsson 提出在验证者数量高于目标时，每个 epoch 从验证者余额中扣减一笔激励：32 ETH 验证者扣得最多（不超过满参与时的 attestation 奖励），随有效余额线性下降，到 2048 ETH 为零，以减少网络承载和聚合投票的负担。他说 FOCIL 按验证者挑选包含者，会让验证者倾向不合并。11-20 16:43 回复称目标是 I* 分叉的 PFI；gregk 在讨论中提到 EIP-8148 已 CFI 进 Hegotá。
items.note_en: (PR #12673), 2026-11-19 02:11. aelowsson proposes that while the validator count is above target, an incentive is deducted from validator balances each epoch: largest for 32 ETH validators (up to their attestation reward at full participation), falling linearly with effective balance to zero at 2048 ETH, to reduce the load of carrying and aggregating votes. He noted that FOCIL picks includers per validator, which pushes validators to stay unconsolidated. In a reply at 11-20 16:43 he said PFI for the I* fork is the target; gregk mentioned in the thread that EIP-8148 is already CFI'd for Hegotá.

items.note: EIP-8502：动态个体合并激励（PR #12673）2026-11-19 02:11，aelowsson 提出在验证者数量高于目标时，每个 epoch 从验证者余额中扣减一笔激励：32 ETH 验证者扣得最多（不超过满参与时的 attestation 奖励），随有效余额线性下降，到 2048 ETH 为零，以减少网络承载和聚合投票的负担。他说 FOCIL 按验证者挑选包含者，会让验证者倾向不合并。11-20 16:43 回复称目标是 I* 分叉的 PFI；gregk 在讨论中提到 EIP-8148 已 CFI 进 Hegotá。
items.note_en: EIP-8502: Dynamic individual consolidation incentive (PR #12673), 2026-11-19 02:11. aelowsson proposes that while the validator count is above target, an incentive is deducted from validator balances each epoch: largest for 32 ETH validators (up to their attestation reward at full participation), falling linearly with effective balance to zero at 2048 ETH, to reduce the load of carrying and aggregating votes. He noted that FOCIL picks includers per validator, which pushes validators to stay unconsolidated. In a reply at 11-20 16:43 he said PFI for the I* fork is the target; gregk mentioned in the thread that EIP-8148 is already CFI'd for Hegotá.

items.title: EIP 草案：Frame 交易的 FOCIL 遗漏见证（PR #12663）
items.note: 2026-11-19 23:37，soispoke 讨论 paymaster 风险：只要赞助方签出的未上链交易 max_fee 总和不超过 paymaster 余额减待提款额，这些交易在任何位置都付得起费，即把 EIP-8141 的 mempool 规则改由赞助方签名时自行执行。
items.title_en: Draft EIP: FOCIL omission witnesses for frame transactions (PR #12663)
items.note_en: 2026-11-19 23:37. soispoke addressed paymaster risk: as long as the summed max_fee of a sponsor's signed but not yet included transactions stays at or below the paymaster balance minus pending withdrawals, every one of them stays payable at any position. In effect the sponsor applies EIP-8141's mempool rule when signing.

items.title: ethresear.ch：EIP-8288 的网络侧
items.note: 2026-11-18 16:58，cskiraly 用离散事件模拟器研究递归聚合的网络选择。以接近今天的 15 笔/秒签名交易计算，其他节点平均上传带宽约 0.4 Mbit/s（2.5 kB 签名）或 1 Mbit/s（7,740 字节签名），今天的 mempool 能承载；聚合的意义在于承载 STARK 见证过大的隐私交易并进一步扩容。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: the networking side of EIP-8288
items.note_en: 2026-11-18 16:58. cskiraly built a discrete-event simulator for recursive aggregation's networking choices. At 15 signature transactions per second, close to today's rate, other nodes uploaded about 0.4 Mbit/s on average with 2.5 kB signatures or 1 Mbit/s with 7,740-byte signatures, which today's mempool can carry. Aggregation matters for carrying privacy transactions whose STARK witnesses are too big to gossip, and for scaling further.

items.title: PQ-CL Breakout #3 纪要
items.note: 2026-11-21 00:05（会议 11-20 21:00）：PQ devnet 因客户端没用紧凑密钥加载而启动慢，决定采用 PR 802；模拟显示 GossipSub 难以在一个 slot 里处理 3.2 万个签名，devnet 将同时测试 GossipSub 和 Waggle；聚合在 NUC 上约 3 秒；讨论了迁移合约用 XMSS 签名、可能要求 0x02 凭证，以及丢失密钥的 0x00 验证者恢复机制。PQ-CL Breakout #4 定于 11-24 21:00。
items.note_en: 2026-11-21 00:05 (call held 11-20 21:00): the PQ devnet started slowly because clients weren't using compact key loading, so the group chose PR 802. Simulations suggest GossipSub struggles with 32,000 signatures in a slot, so the devnet will test both GossipSub and Waggle. Aggregation takes about 3 seconds on a NUC. They also discussed XMSS signatures for the migration contract, possibly requiring 0x02 credentials, and a recovery path for 0x00 validators who lost their keys. PQ-CL Breakout #4 is set for 11-24 21:00.

summary_en: ACDE #249 reached rough consensus to ship Glamsterdam on the current spec with EIP-8037 unchanged. A Hoodi testnet fork is pencilled in for the week of December 14, with the final call at the next ACDC. ChainSecurity's public impact assessment found that 182 of 200 findings involve hard-coded gas budgets. On Hegotá, the option of dropping frames in favour of enshrined PQ got no support, client teams owe written positions by the end of next week, and FOCIL's fate goes to the next two ACDC calls. The PR raising EIP-8141's MAX_VERIFY_GAS to 300k now has benchmarks from all 7 execution clients, with a worst-case median rejection time of 3.1 to 5.3 ms.
